% fvextra beside listings, with no color package in the preamble, as in
% test-fvcolor-listings. fvextra.4ht restores fancyvrb's inline command,
% so \Verb skips fancyvrb.4ht's color hook, and Verbatim still runs it.
% The font size comes from fancyvrb's keys, global and local.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{fvextra}
\usepackage{listings}
\fvset{fontsize=\small}
\begin{document}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines]
fv-extra
\end{Verbatim}
\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\footnotesize]
fv-footnotesize
\end{Verbatim}
Inline \Verb|fv-extra-inline|.
A listing: \lstinline|fv-lstinline|.
\end{document}
